verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is an incorporation and notarization platform, so recurring compliance filings are a fair question for it. The evidence only covers one-time post-formation registrations: Transparenzregister entry, trade registration (Gewerbeanmeldung) and the tax-office registration questionnaire via ELSTER. There is no evidence of annual report filing, recurring tax filing or deadline tracking. A Compliance API exists on Enterprise plans, but its scope is not described, so it cannot be credited here.
